steps.say: The 7 is in the ten thousands place, so its value is 70,000.
The 0 holds the tens place. Without it, the digits would slide into the wrong places.
Ten lots of 100,000 make one million. We write one million as 1,000,000.

check.prompt: What is the value of the 6 in 365,120?
hints: Put the number in a place value chart.
Count the places from the right: ones, tens, hundreds, thousands.
The number has 6 digits, so its first digit is in the hundred thousands place.
check.explanation: The 6 is in the ten thousands place, so its value is 60,000.

options.why: That is the thousands place. Count the places again from the ones.
The 3 is in the hundred thousands place, not the 6.
The 6 is not in the ones place, so it is worth more than 6.

check.prompt: Write two hundred and six thousand, four hundred and fifty in digits.
hints: Write the thousands part first: two hundred and six thousand.
Then write the last three digits: four hundred and fifty.
Check that your number has 6 digits.
check.explanation: Two hundred and six thousand is 206,000. Add four hundred and fifty to get 206,450.

hints: Find the ten thousands digit in 395,240.
The ten thousands digit is 9, so adding 1 more makes a new hundred thousand.
check.explanation: 395,240 + 10,000 = 405,240. The 9 ten thousands become 10 ten thousands, which is one more hundred thousand.

options.why: That adds 100,000. Change the ten thousands digit.
That adds 1,000. Change the ten thousands digit.
That adds 10. Change the ten thousands digit.
